passive.name: Living Vengeance
passive.desc: On kill or assist, Varus temporarily gains Attack Damage and Ability Power. This bonus is larger if the enemy is a champion.

spells.name: Piercing Arrow
spells.desc: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

spells.name: Blighted Quiver
spells.desc: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

spells.name: Hail of Arrows
spells.desc: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

spells.name: Chain of Corruption
spells.desc: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.
